name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Housing assistance to provide pucca house with basic amenities to all homeless and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 (plains) to ₹1,30,000 (hilly states) + 90 days MGNREGA wages

criteria.description: Applicant must reside in a rural area
criteria.disqualification_reason: PMAY-G is specifically for rural residents

criteria.description: Must be categorized as BPL or homeless / kutcha house household
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not classified as BPL / housing-deprived
